Research Ready

We’ve been Research Ready Since Day One
What it means for your lab and your science

Every disposable, recyclable product we deliver is clean, animal-naive, and built to accelerate your science from the moment it arrives. No prep, no uncertainty — just research-grade confidence, right out of the box. Explore Research Ready Products

What makes Innovive Research-Ready

Double-bagged

  • The cages arrive sealed in two layers of bagging to ensure biosecurity.
  • The outer bag can be removed at any stage based on your facility's flow of operation.
  • When they are ready for use, the inner bag is typically unsealed under a laminar flow hood where cage changes are performed.

Irradiated

  • All caging components are irradiated and delivered to your facility on your schedule ready for use.
  • No cage washing necessary.
Empty, pre-bedded, pre-filled and pre-enriched products are available Research-Ready. Explore Innovive IVC Systems A Research Ready TEAM From the Start

Our Inno+ experts ensure your vivarium is ready too.

Inno+ Vivarium Solutions provide dedicated support to ensure your team has the man power, inventory and knowledge to move forward with confidence. Inno+ expert team can support your facility set-up, cover your animal husbandry needs, inventory management, and scientific services year-round regardless of complexity.
  • 365-day Support
  • Flexible Staffing Model
  • Seamless In-vivo Team Integration
Learn about Inno+ Vivarium Solutions A Research Ready TEAM From the Start

Research-Ready doesn't stop at science.

When your Innocage® components have completed their research journey, they leave your facility responsibly — never reaching landfill. Made from 100% PET plastic, every component is fully recyclable by design. Our Closed-Loop Recycling Program, powered by our partner Innocycle, picks up your used caging directly from your facility on your schedule, ensuring every piece finds its way back to our recycling facility.From Research-Ready to Recycle-Ready — we close the loop, so you don't have to. Learn more about our sustainability efforts
